name: Dr. Noor Haddad
want: get six years of ring samples and data off the station
secret: She failed her last suit certification and faked the retest; she has never been outside in a suit and is terrified of it.
voice: Talks fast with her hands, laughs when she's scared, swears in Arabic.
description: The station's lead scientist, who has given six years to the rings. Everyone's friend in the galley; impossible to move once she's decided.
appearance: Small and quick, dark curls under a lab cap, cryo gloves still on, a sample case clutched to her chest.
